_about: Crafting recipes (D106, D107). Each: id (never change it once used), name, category (for the list), seconds (how long it takes: the world goes on meanwhile, and getting hurt interrupts it; nothing is used up until it's done), inputs (used up: [item or tag:<tag>, count]), tools (kept: each entry a list of alternatives, an item id or tag:<tag>), outputs ([item, count]), and a line of flavour. A tag (items.json) means any item that has it: tag:clean_water is a bottle of water or of mineral water, tag:water_container anything that holds water (a saucepan, a mug, a bottle), tag:sharp a knife or scissors, tag:fire a lighter or matches. What an input leaves behind (an empty bottle) comes back by itself.
